domain_assessment_rule: Assess maturity per domain; never promote the entire product because one critical flow needs a stronger baseline.
threshold_rule: Each consumer assigns measurable thresholds or an explicit pending-baseline gate before architecture promotion.
review_rule: Review monthly or when exposure, dependency, cost, incident or domain-stage changes; promote and regress domains independently.
evolution_rule: Add architectural complexity only when evidence shows the current risk, cost or delay exceeds the lifecycle cost of the proposed complexity.
